title: Spend Standing Sheet: Card-Paid Points Uplift by Agreement Spend under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Rule.** For a flown card-paid segment of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the agreement's spend standing adds to the card-paid uplift. The spend standing is the eligible spend posted to the agreement — its spend entries — in the spend-standing window of 12 calendar months up to and including the posting date.

| Spend standing | Addition to the card-paid uplift |
|---|---|
| at or above the tier's annual spend threshold | 10 percentage points |
| at or above the tier's retention level, and below the threshold | 5 percentage points |
| below the retention level | nothing |

The retention level is the tier's retention percentage of its annual spend threshold.

| Tier | Annual spend threshold (USD) | Retention percentage | Retention level (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 25000 | 80 | 20000 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 150000 | 80 | 120000 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 500000 | 80 | 400000 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 1500000 | 85 | 1275000 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 5000000 | 90 | 4500000 |

**How the card-paid uplift acts.** The card-paid uplift is counted in percentage points; uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the segment's earned card-paid segment points are raised by the total: the points posted are the earned points multiplied by one hundred plus the card-paid uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point once at the end.

### Cases (hypothetical spend standings)

- Crestline Corporate Select with a spend standing of USD 150000.00: at the threshold, 10 percentage points.
- Crestline Corporate Select with USD 120000.00: at the retention level and below the threshold, 5 percentage points.
- Crestline Corporate Select with USD 119999.99: below the retention level, nothing.
- Crestline Business Connect: the threshold is USD 0, so any spend standing, including none, adds 10 percentage points.
